scientific_purpose: Test whether the frozen v0.85 compiler, selectors, exact planners, independent Rust replay, seeds, budgets, and v0.82 acceptance thresholds transfer to genuinely untouched external tabular tasks without any post-inspection tuning.

preserved_evidence.interpretation: v0.85 is opened-data development evidence only. It is not counted as external validation. All prior rejections remain binding and visible regardless of the v0.86 outcome.

external_source.selection_basis: registry metadata and identifiers only; feature values, labels, folds, and task files must not be downloaded or inspected before the immutable task manifest is committed
exclusions: any dataset or byte-identical derivative used in v0.82 through v0.85
any task previously downloaded, inspected, debugged, or mentioned in Mini-ORIGIN development records
tasks that cannot be fetched reproducibly by immutable OpenML task and dataset version identifiers
tasks whose license or availability prevents artifact retention
tasks unsupported by the already-frozen adapter without changing compiler semantics
external_source.manifest_rule: Construct the eligible OpenML-CC18 task-ID list using metadata only, sort ascending by immutable task ID, serialize as canonical UTF-8 JSON, compute SHA-256, and select the first seven eligible task IDs after ordering candidates by SHA-256('mini-origin-v86:' || task_id). Commit the complete eligible list, exclusion reasons, selected IDs, task versions, metadata snapshot, and manifest digest before downloading task data.
external_source.replacement_rule: No replacement is allowed after any selected task content is accessed. A pre-access metadata-only exclusion may be made only by committing the exact reason and regenerating the whole manifest deterministically.

execution_order: implement a metadata-only manifest generator and invariant tests
run it in CI without downloading selected task contents
commit the immutable selected-task manifest and its SHA-256 digest
verify all frozen source-file hashes against the parent commit
download selected tasks exactly once in a dedicated evaluation workflow
retain raw provenance, adapters' outputs, states, Python results, Rust results, evidence, and all failures
apply the unchanged v0.82 gate once with no retries and no substitutions

failure_policy.infrastructure_failure_rule: A rerun is permitted only when no selected task result was revealed and the failure is demonstrably external to the scientific computation; the failure and justification must be committed before rerun.
rejection_conditions: fewer than seven selected tasks contribute
any post-access substitution, threshold change, budget change, or dataset-specific exception

claim_boundary: A pass would be first-party untouched external validation under a preregistered protocol. It would still not constitute independent third-party replication, peer review, a world-class result, or a general breakthrough. A rejection remains scientifically informative and must be preserved unchanged.
